name: mt5-httpapi
description: MetaTrader 5 trading via REST — market data, orders, positions, history, and server-side technical analysis

api_url.title: MT5 API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of your running mt5-httpapi. Use the server root (e.g. http://localhost:8888) to reach every terminal, where tools take broker/account parameters and list_terminals shows what is configured. Use a terminal path (e.g. http://localhost:8888/roboforex/procent) to pin this install to that single terminal.

api_token.title: MT5 API token
api_token.description: Bearer token. Only needed if the API was started with authentication enabled.
